semantic_cases.description: 10 total cases, 1 skipped/cancelled before start, 9 started, 6 verified success, 3 terminal failed -> Case Rate = 6/9 = 66.7%, Unknown Outcome Rate = 3/9 = 33.3%
2 events for same case arriving out of order produce identical final projection row
Duplicate fact with identical source_fact_id ignored; identical source_fact_id with different digest rejected and quarantined
Case active run time 10s, human approval wait 4 hours. Baseline human duration 300s. Time Avoidance = 300 - 10 = 290s (not negative). Active duration = 10s.
Group with 4 contributors -> suppressed with 'cohort_size_insufficient', group with 5 contributors -> metric released with cell counts
Page returns 200 with cell is_suppressed=true and suppression_reason='cohort_size_insufficient', other unsuppressed cells populated normally
Revoking consent for 1 contributor in a 5-contributor cohort moves cohort size to 4, immediately suppressing subsequently generated cells for that cohort
Verified case with manual correction applied. Baseline = 120s, runtime = 15s, correction time = 45s. Time Avoidance = 120 - 15 - 45 = 60s.
Case executed with outcome verified_no_op. Time Avoidance = 0s.
Workflows spending USD and EUR across runs aggregate into separate currency buckets without silent arbitrary conversion
Approval wait interval union: [10:00, 10:15] and [10:10, 10:30] merged to [10:00, 10:30] (20 minutes, not 35 minutes).
Pre-release regression = 10%, Post-release regression = 4% -> improvement of 6% (regression change = -6 percentage points). Pre = 2%, Post = 8% -> degradation of +6 percentage points.
3 incidents for same workflow grouped, MTTR calculated as median elapsed time from opened_at to recovered_at.
Pilot start 2026-03-01T00:00:00 in America/New_York ends after 14 calendar days (335 wall-clock hours due to spring-forward DST transition).
Only notifications in delivered or pending state can be snoozed; snoozing a resolved notification rejected with 409 conflict.
Critical severity notification (e.g. security policy revoked) bypasses quiet hours; warning/info notifications suppressed until quiet hours window ends.
Cell containing =cmd|' /C calc'!A0 or @SUM(1+1) prefixed with single quote ' in CSV export.
Export exceeding 100MB chunk threshold split into part_001, part_002 with separate SHA-256 digests in manifest.
Worker failure or timeout marks export state as failed with error code and partial artifacts cleaned up.
Querying with Tenant A's session token for Tenant B's report snapshot returns 404 Not Found (not 403, preventing existence leakage).
User lacking operator.case.view sees aggregated workflow topology nodes but individual case drill-down references are omitted.
Disaster recovery replay verifies every journaled snapshot against expected_digest before committing.
Desktop shell uses shell-sync.v1 for sync operations and separate notification channel for notifications; tokens partitioned by audience.
Checkpoints with duplicate sequence numbers within an attempt are deduplicated; missing sequence numbers flag gap detection.
Facts with event timestamps older than watermark can update history dimensions but do not rewind the high-water mark.
Unmonitored risk-tier 0 workflows filtered out of pilot evaluation cohorts.
Timezone America/New_York and Asia/Tokyo correctly partition daily buckets across DST boundaries.
